input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding Customer (sec-23 contains no operative text, and no other inspection, records or remote-monitoring right appears in the document). It satisfies every preferred element: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period, require thirty days' prior written notice, occur during normal business hours, are conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and Vendor bears the costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent. Section 22.2 also bars Vendor and its auditor from accessing Customer systems directly. No redline is warranted; the clause sits at (indeed meets) the preferred position.
